rejected.text: Ayagor is a narrow mountain valley, also called the Dragon's Bowl, where Atarka roosts and her clan feeds her.
Pages describe it as a high, shallow valley that resembles a dinner platter, where Atarka assembles her clan to feed her.

It is also called a mountaintop stone bowl where Atarka lounges and receives offerings, and later pages call it a permanent encampment where meat is delivered to her and where she feasts and takes hunting fledglings.
The latest mention, in 2018, still describes Ayagor as the gathering place where Atarka feasts and takes hunting fledglings.
